1 .  Through the medium of present contempt petition, the petitioners are seeking implementation of order dated 15.02.2023 passed in the writ petition.

The same is reproduced as under:-
" (i) Be that as it may, since the Indenting Department has already submitted its proposal to the Collector and also to the Horticulture Department for assessment of fruit/non-fruit bearing trees, therefore, we deem it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition with direction to the Collector and Horticulture/Revenue Department to culminate the process of the acquisition and also CP (S) No. 201/2023 in assess the fruit/non-fruit bearing trees strictly in terms of provisions governing the field.
Madan Singh

sentences.text: (ii) Let the Collector and the concerned Revenue/Horticulture Department to do the needful in terms of communication dated 16.08.2022 issued by Superintendent Engineer PWD (R&B) Circle, Doda within eight weeks from the date copy of this order is served upon them.
(iii) Respondent No. 6 to complete and further forwarded the indent to the Collector concerned within a period of two weeks.

Upon receiving, the Collector shall also complete the process of acquisition as well as assessment within six weeks,
thereafter, from the date copy of this order is served upon him.

(iv) Disposed of."
2.

Pursuant to the aforesaid direction, it seems that preliminary notification under Section 11(1) of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as "Act of 2013") stands issued by the Collector on 15.10.2024 in respect of land measuring 13 Kanals 2 marlas situated in Village-Neera, Tehsil and District- Ramban for the purpose of construction of road from Ramban to Adwah via Shargali, on the basis of indent placed by Chief Engineer CP (S) No. 201/2023 in PW(R&B) Department, Chenab Zone, Batote vide his communication dated 09.05.2024.
3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In the compliance report submitted by the Indenting Department it has been submitted that an amount of Rs.20.43 lacs. stands deposited with the Collector on 26.03.2025 and besides this a further sum of Rs.22.40 lacs/- stands already deposited with the Collector meaning thereby that a total amount of Rs.42,83,000/- stands deposited with the Collector.

According to the Indenting Department aforesaid amount of Rs.42.83 lacs constitutes the amount of compensation payable in respect of the land owned by the petitioners, which stands deposited with the Collector.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent- Collector has submitted that further sum of Rs.3,44,43,195/- representing the tentative cost of the land proposed to be acquired is required to be deposited by the Indenting Department so as to enable the Government to issue a declaration under Section 19 (1) Act of 2013.
It has been further submitted that a communication in this regard has been sent to the Indenting Department on 07.10.2025.

5. Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG appearing on behalf of the Indenting Department has submitted that the Indenting Department is only required deposit the tentative cost of the land belonging to the petitioners and not the tentative cost of whole of the land sought CP (S) No.
201/2023 in to be acquired because the other land owners have not agitated their claim before this Court or before any other forum.

6. I am afraid the contention of the learned AAG cannot be accepted for the reason that the indent placed by the Indenting Department is with respect to land measuring 13 kanals and 2 marlas and not with respect to the land belonging to the petitioners only which is measuring 1 kanal and 6 marlas.
A Collector cannot proceed ahead with the acquisition in piecemeals.

As per proviso to Section 19(2) of the Act of 2013, the declaration cannot be made unless the Requiring Body, deposits Madan Singh And Another vs Shailender Kumar And Others on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43892133/
2 in full or part cost of the acquisition.

entities.text: Madan Singh And Another vs Shailender Kumar And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Rule 6(1) of the Rules further provides that Requiring Body has to deposit the estimated cost of acquisition with the Collector without which the process under the Act cannot continue.
Thus the Collector in absence of deposit of the estimated cost of acquisition would not be in a position to proceed further in the instant case.
The contention of the learned AAG is therefore, misconceived.

7. If the Indenting Department is either not interested in acquiring the land other than the land of petitioners or it has acquired the land of other land owners either on the basis of private negotiation or in accordance with any other legal mode, then the Indenting Department has to withdraw its indent and submit a fresh indent with regard to the land of petitioners only, so that the acquisition proceedings to that extent can proceed further.
In the above context, Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG shall take instructions in the matter and inform this Court on the next date of hearing.
In case, the Indenting Department is desirous of acquiring the whole of the land measuring 13 kanals 2 marla, they shall deposit the balance amount with the Collector by next date of hearing.

(SANJAY DHAR) JUDGE JAMMU 08.10.2025 Mahavir Madan Singh And Another vs Shailender Kumar And Others on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43892133/
